summary: Backend services for real-time data, in production.
highlights: Designed and built Python microservices for real-time data processing, making the system more scalable and reliable in production.
Built and maintained REST APIs and backend services in Python and Node.js, covering business logic, integrations and data workflows.
Cut latency by 40–50% by optimizing PostgreSQL queries and system bottlenecks.
Moved heavy workloads to asynchronous pipelines, so they never block user requests.
Diagnosed and fixed complex production issues in real-time data flows.
